Orbit Networks LLC is growing and seeking an experienced Senior Backend Engineer for our platform services group. We build software used by millions of people every day.

Responsibilities:
• Optimize service performance and database queries.
• Improve resilience through monitoring and incident reviews.
• Design scalable APIs and data models for customer-facing products.
• Write clear technical documentation for internal consumers.
• Work with JIRA, and AI Agents to deliver reliable features.

Requirements:
• Solid understanding of Continuous Deployment, Azure and C#.NET.
• Strong proficiency in Data Visualization, Java and Azure Functions.
• Solid understanding of Amazon Web Services and GitHub Workflows.

Nice to have:
• Nice to have: decomposing monoliths into independent backend services, End-to-End Testing, RESTful services, SQL Server, Git, Generative AI and Rust lang.

About us:
• Benefits include health coverage, equity, remote-friendly work and a supportive culture.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Join Cobalt Group LLC as a Full Stack Developer and make an impact from day one. We power online marketplaces and fast, reliable delivery.

Responsibilities:
• Translate product requirements into well designed, maintainable software.
• Participate in code reviews and mentor teammates.
• Estimate work and break features into deliverable increments.
• Troubleshoot production issues and improve system reliability.
• Design, build and maintain services using Scalable systems and Java.

Requirements:
• Solid understanding of SQL / Angular 2 / Prometheus monitoring.
• Solid understanding of AI Agents, REST API, and Spring Boot.

Nice to have:
• Familiarity with Microservices, PHP7, TypeScript, CPP, and Test-Driven Development is a plus.

About us:
• We offer competitive pay, flexible working hours, learning budget and generous time off.
• Our customers love the C-suite dashboards we ship.

title: Lead Back-End Software Engineer
description:

  • Our spring hiring cohort starts in April.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:

  • Please express interest by applying through our careers page.

title: Information Security Analyst
description:
Cobalt Dynamics Ltd is growing and seeking an experienced Information Security Analyst for our security operations group. We are modernizing payments and lending for customers worldwide.

Responsibilities:
• Maintain security policies and audit evidence.
• Run tabletop exercises and security awareness sessions.
• Assess systems for vulnerabilities and drive remediation.
• Monitor, triage and respond to security alerts.
• Work with Threat Intelligence, and Python2 to deliver reliable features.

Requirements:
• 2+ years of experience with MATLAB and VPN.
• Expertise in Ansible and AWS is required.
• Demonstrated experience with Tableau.

Nice to have:
• Bonus points for experience with Kubernetes, Compliance, Unit Testing, Containerisation, and Golang.

About us:
• We offer competitive pay, flexible working hours, learning budget and generous time off.
• Please express interest by applying through our careers page.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Beacon Group Corp is growing and seeking an experienced AI Engineer for our applied AI group. We power online marketplaces and fast, reliable delivery.

Responsibilities:
• Train, evaluate and deploy machine learning systems at scale.
• Work with researchers to productionize prototypes.

• Build reliable data and feature pipelines for models.
• Collaborate with engineers to improve our Llama, and Predictive models stack.

Requirements:
• Solid understanding of LangChain, REST API, Systems design and Amazon AWS.
• Working knowledge of Kubernetes, GenerativeAI and Git.

Nice to have:

What we offer:
• Benefits include health coverage, equity, remote-friendly work and a supportive culture.
